qa_pairs.question: What information does the CPU graph provide when viewing a GPU task page in Metrix?
qa_pairs.answer: On a GPU task page in Metrix, the CPU graph allows users to visualize the usage of the requested CPU cores over time. Users can also select or deselect different cores as needed.

qa_pairs.question: Are there any limitations to viewing the CPU graph on a GPU task page in Metrix?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, the CPU graph, which displays the utilization of CPU cores over time, is not available for very short tasks.
